service.en: Link Abu Dhabi Chamber membership to TAMM
service.ar: ربط عضوية غرفة أبوظبي بحساب تم
service.ur: ابوظہبی چیمبر کی رکنیت کو تم سے منسلک کرنا
service.ml: അബുദാബി ചേംബർ അംഗത്വം തം അക്കൗണ്ടുമായി ബന്ധിപ്പിക്കൽ

about: Link a Chamber membership to your TAMM account so you can use member-only Chamber services.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
